text:
Elaine: Heads-up — after PTQ on reranker-v2, ndcg@10 drops ~2.3% on our customer-support holdout, but median query-level delta looks small. anybody seen long-tail regressions like this post-PTQ? :eyes:

Rohan: can you paste the eval job id and dataset split? is this across all query lengths or concentrated?

Elaine: Eval job id: eval-20260221-42. Using combined holdout (temporal last-2w). I stratified by frequency only, not token-length. Quick numbers: NDCG@10 baseline 0.487 -> PTQ 0.476 (paired doc-level bootstrap p~0.03). MRR down ~1.1%.

Joel: two quick asks: 1) run paired bootstrap at the query level (group by query_id), not doc-level. 2) compute NDCG broken out by query-length quantiles — small-sample variance in tail can skew the overall p-value.

Elaine: I was doing doc-level earlier — switching to query-level now. Do we have a recommended paired-bootstrap script (B=10k?) to reuse?

Kai: use the eval-harness wrapper: `tools/eval/paired_bootstrap.py --metric ndcg@10 --group-by query_id --B 10000 --seed 42`. We also support `--stratify length_bucket` to preserve length distribution in resamples.

Rohan: also inspect the raw reranker score distribution. PTQ often compresses logits which makes cutoffs brittle; check pos vs neg score gap and rank histogram shift.

Elaine: running score-gap diffs now. will also compute per-length-bucket ndcg and effect sizes.

deploy-bot: eval job started: eval-20260221-42 -> job 8675309 (status: queued) :rocket:

Joel: small note: besides bootstrap, compute a non-parametric paired test like Wilcoxon as a sanity check, and report Cliff's delta for effect size (gives practical significance).

Elaine: quick results from query-level paired bootstrap (B=10k): ndcg delta = -0.011 (95% CI [-0.017, -0.005]), p=0.004. Breaking out by length: length>80 tokens bucket delta = -0.032 (CI [-0.052, -0.012]). Score-gap (pos - highest-neg) mean reduced by ~0.14 logits in long queries. Chart attached to eval job. :chart_with_downwards_trend:

Kai: that pattern screams quantization sensitivity in later layers (attention key/query scaling or outlier weight clipping). Try per-layer mixed-precision: keep last 3-4 transformer layers in fp16, quantize rest to int8/4. Also test asymmetric vs symmetric quant params.

Elaine: plan: run two configs on staging canary — (A) baseline PTQ, (B) keep layers 21-24 fp16 + int8 elsewhere. Also run the asym vs sym quant parameter sweep. Any objections to a small traffic canary?

Rohan: fine. rollout policy: canary at 2% traffic with rollback triggers: overall ndcg drop > 0.01 OR any length-bucket drop > 0.02. Also log per-query deltas for debugging.

Elaine: perfect — I'll kick off the runs, push plots and raw deltas to rerank/ptq/issue-42, and follow up with a short postmortem if we need a model-config lock. Thanks all.
